name: maximal_cliques
author: 7065a2b5
description: Finds maximal cliques (groups of nodes in which every pair is directly connected, that cannot be extended by another node) with the Bron-Kerbosch algorithm with pivoting, and returns the largest ones. Use it for questions like 'what is the largest group where everyone knows everyone?', 'how big is the biggest tightly-knit group?', 'how many maximal cliques are there?' or, with node, 'which cliques does Alice belong to?'. Works on undirected and directed graphs (on directed graphs edge direction is ignored); weights are ignored. Returns the total number of maximal cliques, the largest clique size, counts per size, and the top_k largest cliques with their members (id and label); each clique is registered as a subgraph (its graph_id), and result_graph_id is the largest clique, so other tools can run on it.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to analyse.

top_k.description: How many of the largest cliques to return, biggest first.

node.description: Optional node id: only return cliques that contain this node. Use lookup_node to find the id from a name.
